content.title: About
content.content: Canned orange NFS (3933) consists of whole orange segments packed in their own juice with a touch of sugar and preservative for long‑term storage. The fruit retains its characteristic aroma, sweet‑tart flavor, and most of the vitamins found in fresh oranges.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Canned oranges are frequently used in desserts, salads, and baked goods where a stable taste and texture are required.
Unlike fresh fruit, canned segments are easier to digest and less prone to spoilage during extended storage.
The canning process preserves up to 80 % of vitamin C, which otherwise degrades quickly in fresh fruit.
NFS oranges are sourced from varieties selected for high juiciness and aroma.
Canned orange is often served as a garnish for meat dishes in Asian cuisine.

items.title: Rich in vitamin C
items.content: Vitamin C supports the immune system, aids collagen synthesis, and acts as an antioxidant.

items.title: Contains flavonoids
items.content: Flavonoids such as hesperidin help protect cells from oxidative stress.

items.title: Source of potassium
items.content: Potassium helps regulate fluid balance and supports normal heart function.

items.title: Low in fat
items.content: Canned orange contains virtually no fat, making it suitable for low‑calorie diets.

items.title: Supports digestion
items.content: Dietary fiber promotes regular bowel movements and contributes to satiety.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Even modest added sugar may be undesirable for individuals monitoring blood glucose levels.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Some preservatives can trigger allergic reactions in sensitive people.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: High acidity may irritate the stomach lining in persons with gastritis or ulcers.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Canned orange can be eaten straight from the jar, added to fruit salads, yogurts, desserts, baked goods, or used in sauces for meat and fish. It is advisable to drain excess juice before serving.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the unopened jar in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep it refrigerated in its original container and consume within 5‑7 days. Discard if any off‑odor or discoloration appears.
